root.statement: Under the owner-authorized SoulCord V1 migration, replace the currently broken DM-blocking Link Lens and incomplete utility experience with a reversible, provenance-controlled power suite while preserving user data, upstream compatibility, and human-reserved acceptance.
root.source_state: The installed SoulCord build shows a translation sentinel, a persistent low-contrast link overlay that obstructs DMs, a rejected crystal/orbit mark, and only three enabled daily addons.
root.target_state: A tested SoulCord build provides repaired navigation, native review UI, original branding, a versioned setup transaction, curated addons, private timeline controls, rollback evidence, and an owner-ready Windows launch.
conditions: Do not alter existing user plugins, themes, settings, MessageLogger data, or the vanilla Activities launcher before a verified backup and staged transaction.
Do not perform live account-representational actions without fresh action-time owner confirmation.
Do not vendor or modify third-party payloads without controlling rights evidence.
root.boundary: The slaveofsolace/Solcord fork, its owner branch, local BetterDiscord and Discord installation, supplied archives, official catalog metadata, and rights-cleared project assets.

intent.summary: Deliver a distinctive SoulCord power fork with repaired DMs, broad useful addon coverage, private local controls, and a reversible Windows installation.
intent.unknown_disposition: Human taste acceptance remains reserved for the owner.

decision.summary: Repair the navigation blocker first, then advance only staged features that pass rights, security, runtime, and recovery gates.
decision.unknown_disposition: A failing downstream gate reduces installed scope rather than weakening the gate.

acceptance_contract.summary: Automated, installed-runtime, visual, recovery, and explicit human acceptance are separate gates.
acceptance_contract.unknown_disposition: Owner visual approval and live Activity checks remain open until performed.

mechanism.summary: SoulCord now has source implementations for narrow native Link Lens interception, schema-v3 setup, immutable staged acquisition, private Timeline storage, and fail-closed Discord lookups.
mechanism.unknown_disposition: Source presence does not prove installed integration; validate every adapter, failure path, and rollback before installation.

current_state_history.summary: The owner branch began clean at the requested checkpoint and now contains reviewable SoulCord runtime and catalog/identity commits; supplied archive and current catalog hashes are recorded.
current_state_history.unknown_disposition: Installed artifact identity and final process state remain to be revalidated immediately before rollout.

people_incentives.summary: The owner wants broad local utility and controls final taste and risky-action acceptance; upstream authors retain attribution and license rights.
people_incentives.unknown_disposition: No third-party author permission is inferred beyond controlling licenses and official catalog distribution.

lifecycle_recovery.summary: Source push and local install are authorized only after green gates, with a hashed backup and preserved vanilla launcher.
lifecycle_recovery.unknown_disposition: Backup restore and installed rollback must be exercised before closure.

invariants.statement: Preserve existing plugins, themes, settings, custom CSS, MessageLogger data, and compatibility state unless the owner explicitly completes a staged diff.
Do not send messages, upload or record media, mark notifications read, join voice, start streams or Activities, or authorize OAuth without fresh action-time confirmation.
Keep public BdApi, addon paths, public IPC names, preload globals, and ordinary Discord windows compatible.
No external source or asset enters the combined work without a fail-closed provenance disposition and retained notices.
Installation has a verified true rollback to the preserved prior state.

Back up and install a validated SoulCord build, then launch Discord.
forbidden_actions: Merge or change the default branch, publish a release, or delete branches.
Overwrite or delete existing user addons, themes, settings, logs, or the vanilla launcher.
Perform live account-representational actions without fresh action-time confirmation.

hard_gates.rationale: The owner explicitly requested implementation, validation, push, reversible install, and launch while reserving specified account actions.
Risky experiments remain separately consented, fail closed, and off by default.

Current work is confined to source and evidence; Message Timeline remains disabled and uninstalled, acquisition payloads stay outside the repository, and privacy/runtime tests remain a hard pre-install gate.
Only the named owner branch push and local installation are authorized; live account actions remain reserved.
The selected action is a reviewable source repair; installation remains a later separately gated action.
The owner reserves subjective acceptance, but source repair and evidence creation do not claim or consume that decision.
The source repair is isolated in reviewable commits that can be reverted before any user-data migration or installation.

hypotheses.statement: The DM blocker is caused by Link Lens owning a raw document-level capture listener and overlay outside the native modal lifecycle.
hypotheses.mechanism: An external-link click is stopped during capture and a scope-owned fixed overlay remains above Discord navigation until explicitly closed or disposed.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: Removing the capture listener and native-lifecycle bypass eliminates the overlay while internal DM routes remain untouched.
hypotheses.falsifier: A disposable build without Link Lens still reproduces the same overlay and DM obstruction.
hypotheses.decision_if_true: Replace the listener and raw overlay with a narrowly patched external-link activation and native modal.

confidence.basis: Current capture and directly inspected mechanism agree.

hypotheses.statement: A stale installed renderer or mismatched stylesheet contributes to the poor contrast or persistence.
hypotheses.mechanism: Installed asar content differs from current source, so current CSS fixes are absent while old runtime code remains active.
hypotheses.distinguishing_prediction: The installed asar hash or extracted implementation differs from the owner-branch production artifact.
hypotheses.falsifier: Installed and rebuilt source hashes match while the defect reproduces.
hypotheses.decision_if_true: Include a clean atomic reinstall after the source repair and invalidate stale injection state.

confidence.basis: The screenshot styling differs from inspected CSS, but installed identity is not frozen yet.

predicted_outcomes.outcome: Only the current raw Link Lens path creates the blocking review layer; the native replacement leaves DMs navigable without an installation-wide reset.
The obstruction persists across disposable module states until the installed asar is replaced with the exact rebuilt artifact.

tests.changes_decision_if: If the overlay persists without Link Lens, inspect the conflicting addon or stale installed bundle before enabling catalog additions.

predicted_outcomes.outcome: A differing hash explains why inspected source styling and installed behavior diverge.

tests.changes_decision_if: A match shifts the cause entirely to runtime integration; a mismatch requires atomic reinstall before installed acceptance.

bounds.stop_rule: Expand only branches that change implementation, acceptance, privacy, rights, installation, or rollback.

nodes.statement: The installed SoulCord V1 experience obstructs DMs and does not deliver the authorized utility and identity wave.
A global capture listener creates a raw overlay outside Discord's native modal lifecycle.
A narrow verified external-link patch and native modal restore navigation ownership and focus lifecycle.
Broad addon value requires current catalog provenance, staging, conflict detection, and one-at-a-time enablement.
Private timeline persistence requires encryption, account isolation, retention, and diagnostic exclusion evidence.
A hashed backup and verified restore gate must precede installation.
